projects.title: Study-Session Scheduler
bullets: Implemented a menu-driven study-session scheduler in Python using functions and collections for an individual course project.
Added input checks, handled invalid entries, tested representative inputs, and recorded expected outputs for the scheduler.

projects.title: Contact Index
bullets: Used Python and Git for a contact index project, implementing linked structures and traversal operations.
Wrote tests for insertion, lookup, and deletion, and documented operation costs and boundary cases.
